name: Ann Heard Voices
source:
Pain.
Chaos.
Suffering.
Hatred.
Death.

All now live in fear of the [b]PUN-DEMIC[/b].

Who could have brought such suffering to the whole world?

The answer to mankind's A̶N̶N̶-̶i̶h̶i̶l̶a̶t̶i̶o̶n̶ lies A̶N̶N̶-̶k̶n̶o̶w̶n̶ to everyone else, miserably bearing the burden of the [b]P̶U̶N̶D̶I̶T̶S̶[/b], all A̶N̶N̶ her own.

All because o̶f̶
[b]ANN HEARD VOICES[/b]

[From [url=https://wololoik.itch.io/ann-heard-voices]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
疼痛。
混乱。
苦难。
憎恨。
死亡。

如今，所有人都活在[b]双关瘟疫[/b]的恐惧之中。

究竟是谁，给整个世界带来了如此深重的苦难？

人类覆灭（A̶N̶N̶-̶i̶h̶i̶l̶a̶t̶i̶o̶n̶）的答案，对其他人而言仍是未知（A̶N̶N̶-̶k̶n̶o̶w̶n̶）。唯有安独自悲惨地承担着[b]双̶关̶大̶师̶们̶[/b]的重担。

只因̶为̶
[b]安听见了声音[/b]
